DoubtBackup.title: DoubtBackup
DoubtBackup.description: Cloud-synced doubt item backed up from the local Room database for a user.

localId.description: Original Room database row ID on the client device.

query.description: The spoken or typed doubt question.

oneSentenceSummary.description: Optional single-sentence summary for quick list scanning.

customTag.description: User-assigned custom label such as Work, Education, or Personal.

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds when the doubt was recorded locally.

isResolved.description: Whether the doubt has been resolved.

isStarred.description: Whether the user pinned or favorited this doubt.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

SessionBackup.title: SessionBackup
SessionBackup.description: Cloud-synced Answer Engine conversation session backed up from Room.

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds when the session was saved.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

/users/{userId}/doubts/{doubtId}.description: Per-user backed up DoubtItem records isolated by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Per-user backed up ConversationSession records isolated by Firebase Auth UID.
